thread:
deploybot: Promotion attempt for release manifest-2026-03-24 failed during index compaction: 2 missing blob refs reported. Promotion paused.

maria: Saw 500s in staging on blob GETs.

aj: Can someone paste the compactor log?

deploybot: compact_index.go:130: ERROR missing blob c9b12a (expected refs=1)
compact_index.go:137: INFO retrying compaction (attempt 2)
mirror-sync.go:92: WARN mirror push completed but index mismatch noted

devops: Looks like compaction ran concurrently with the mirror push. Index-cron at 03:00 UTC overlapped with artifact mirror job.

maria: We have a 1-hour change window starting now. Can we pin to last-known-good manifest to avoid delaying rollout?

aj: Recommend: `deployctl promote --target=prod --pin-manifest=manifest-2026-03-23-2218`

release-manager: Risks?

sre-oncall: Pinning to a signed manifest is safe; clients validate digests. Tradeoff is that the newest bundle won't be in prod yet.

devops: I'll reindex and re-run compaction under a cluster lock, ETA ~10m.

maria: Please proceed with manual pin so release window isn't missed.

aj: Manual promote executed at 1743332120 -> success. Prod now serving manifest-2026-03-23-2218. Auto-promote suspended for 45m.

devops: Reindex finished at 1743332138. Missing refs re-registered; compaction patched to acquire global lock (PR #4903). Second compaction run clean.

release-manager: Adding note to release: 'Promoted previous manifest due to index compaction/mirror race; full reindex completed.'

maria: Filing follow-up to add integration test preventing compaction+push overlap.

sre-oncall: Incident labeled P2; follow-ups assigned.

maria: Closing thread, thanks everyone.
